announcements.description: All are welcome! Consider grabbing a seat with someone new for our weekly meal together in the Fellowship Hall.

announcements.title: Congregational Meeting | Sunday, August 30
announcements.description: Join us for a congregational meeting during Fellowship Lunch this Sunday, immediately following worship in the Fellowship Hall.

announcements.title: Parent Meeting | Sunday, August 23
announcements.description: As we prepare for another year of Sunday School, we'd love for all parents of children participating in Sunday School (2 & 3 year olds through 12th grade) to join us for a brief meeting immediately following the morning worship service in the Sanctuary. Pastor Jerry and our Sunday School teachers will share the vision for the coming year, introduce the new curriculum, explain what families can expect and give space for questions. We look forward to partnering with you as we seek to help our covenant children know, love, and follow Christ.

announcements.description:

Sign up here!

announcements.description: Moms with young kids: join our WhatsApp group to stay up to date with meet-ups this summer! Some happening on weekends too! Reach out to Meg Bogue for more information: mhbogue@me.com

announcements.title: Vocation Journal | "Koinonia" Now Available!
announcements.description: "Koinonia", CPC's inaugural journal, is now available! Pick up a copy — it highlights different members of CPC and how they view their work in light of God's grace.

announcements.title: Summer Schedule Now in Effect
announcements.description: We're on a summer break from Sunday school, Fellowship Lunches, and pastor drop-in office hours. You're always welcome to set up a separate time with Pastor Craig (craig.luekens@cpcnewhaven.org), or Pastor Jerry (jerry.ornelas@cpcnewhaven.org).

announcements.title: Pastor's Book Pick | Life Together, by Dietrich Bonhoeffer
announcements.description:
A modern classic, we're treading into deep waters with this one! Written by pastor-theologian and martyr, Life Together is Bonhoeffer's vision for the Christian life, both individually and communally.
Copies in the foyer — suggested donation of $15.

announcements.title: Interested in Joining the Body of Christ at CPC?
announcements.description:
We consider the church an essential element of the gospel, so joining CPC as a member is a way to truly join the body of Christ, in all its blessings and with all its flaws! Before joining, you'll meet one-on-one with a pastor and then discuss how you've come to know Christ with the Shepherd Leaders.
Contact Alexis Vano (admin@cpcnewhaven.org) to begin the process.

announcements.title: Life Groups and Discipleship Groups
announcements.description:
Life Groups and Discipleship Groups are our way of doing "church in the small" where we meet throughout Greater New Haven to be engaged in prayer, teaching, fellowship and care.
For information on which Life Group may be a good fit, contact Alexis, (admin@cpcnewhaven.org).

announcements.title: Join "CPC Social!" on WhatsApp
announcements.description: If you're interested in connecting more spontaneously with CPC folks, you're welcome to join our WhatsApp group "CPC Social!"
